method.name: Integer Linear Programming with PuLP + CBC solver
steps: Define Ad1, Ad2 as integer LpVariables with lower bound 0
Add constraint: Ad1 + Ad2 >= 50  (minimum effectiveness score)
Extract optimal solution (Ad1*, Ad2*) and total cost
method.why: Small 2-variable integer program with linear constraints — direct ILP with CBC is the standard approach, verified on similar budget-allocation planning tasks (orarla_1, orarla_2). HiGHS backend is known to fail on this class.
